original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Preserve requested-executable OSError diagnostics in the opt-in PR5463 Windows Git stream owner, without contaminating binary responses or confusing launched exit 129 with setup failure.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit PR5463/Discussion4681 launch-diagnostic handoff before drawing another card. This is a native process-interface repair, not a compressed-payload comparison.
bottleneck_link: Reliable source-pin validation is a prerequisite for reviewing research. Losing launch failures behind an empty-response error hides deployment faults; this tooling result claims no mathematical improvement.
stop_rule: Stop after direct/native/frozen-reader diagnostic comparisons, literal protocol and startup/descendant cleanup controls, normal/optimized replay and a portable source export. Production adoption and full predecessor audit remain separate.
evidence: Native Windows normal and optimized checks pass the 25 named case groups, including seven malformed-report controls, three regression mutations, and four retained-handle descendant cases. See evidence/ and README for registered/export coverage and limitations.
author: Mihir Srivastava
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent. Author-checked; no independent human or separate-agent review.

open_questions.question: Can the reviewed owner and launch-status wrapper be adopted in the shared Git blob runner?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The shared production runner still lacks native Windows descendant ownership.
open_questions.first_step: Integrate behind a single process factory, retain the existing closed-stdin and mock fixture seams, and run the current Git-source consumer suites on Windows and POSIX.
open_questions.blocked_by: Separate production integration and review of the full adapter; this package deliberately leaves shared scripts unchanged.

open_questions.question: Does the launch/cleanup boundary work under other Windows job policies and interpreter builds?
open_questions.why_it_matters: One native host plus nested registered-launcher jobs do not cover restrictive jobs or every CreateProcess failure.
open_questions.first_step: Run the same --require-windows command on a second Windows host; retain native error fingerprints and before-teardown handle observations.
open_questions.blocked_by: Access to another host/policy. Hard owner death and general Popen compatibility are outside this wrapper.
